title: Add i18n strings for export history, save status, and draft recovery
action: Add all new translation keys to src/i18n/translations.ts for both en and zh-CN locales.
implementation:
Add the following keys to both locales in translations.ts:
- editorStatusSaving: 'Saving...' / '保存中...'
- editorStatusSavedAt: 'Saved at {time}' / '已于 {time} 保存'
- editorStatusIdle: '' (empty, no display when idle)
- exportHistoryTitle: 'Recent Exports' / '最近导出'
- exportHistoryEmpty: 'No exports yet' / '暂无导出记录'
- exportHistoryFormat: '{format} export' / '{format} 导出'
- editorDraftRestored: 'Draft restored' / '草稿已恢复'
- editorDraftRestoredAt: 'Draft restored — saved {time}' / '草稿已恢复 — {time}保存'
Follow existing i18n pattern: flat key structure, no nesting. Add after existing export/editor keys.
